lines.text: Judah's southern border started at the Salt Sea, and its western border was the coastline of the Great Sea.
By the LORD's command, Joshua gave Caleb Hebron, and Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak.
Caleb offered his daughter Acsah in marriage to whoever captured Kiriath-sepher, and Gideon son of Caleb's brother Kenaz captured it.
Acsah asked her father for springs of water, and Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Hebron, so to this day they live there among Judah.
